# Termly

## Sitemaps
- [XML Sitemap](https://termly.io/sitemap_index.xml): Includes all crawlable and indexable pages.

> Termly is an all-in-one compliance platform that provides legal policy generators, consent management tools, and privacy compliance solutions for websites, apps, and businesses.

## Products

### Policy Generators

- [Privacy Policy Generator](https://termly.io/products/privacy-policy-generator/) — Generates customized privacy policies for websites, apps, ecommerce stores, SaaS businesses, and other businesses based on their data practices and applicable privacy requirements.
- [Terms and Conditions Generator](https://termly.io/products/terms-and-conditions-generator/) — Generates customized terms and conditions that establish rules for using a website, app, or online service and help businesses define their terms of use.
- [Cookie Policy Generator](https://termly.io/products/cookie-policy-generator/) — Generates cookie policies that explain how a website uses cookies and tracking technologies and how users can manage their preferences.
- [Impressum Generator](https://termly.io/products/impressum-generator/) — Generates an Impressum for websites that need to provide business and service-provider information under applicable German requirements.
- [EULA Generator](https://termly.io/products/eula-generator/) — Generates End User License Agreements for apps and software, including terms governing permitted use, restrictions, and intellectual property.
- [Acceptable Use Policy Generator](https://termly.io/products/acceptable-use-policy-generator/) — Generates an Acceptable Use Policy defining permitted and prohibited uses of a website, app, or online service.
- [Disclaimer Generator](https://termly.io/products/disclaimer-generator/) — Generates disclaimers for websites, blogs, apps, and other online properties to communicate limitations, responsibilities, and applicable disclosures.
- [Return and Refund Policy Generator](https://termly.io/products/refund-return-policy-generator/) — Generates return and refund policies for ecommerce businesses, covering rules for returns, refunds, exchanges, and related customer requirements.
- [Shipping Policy Generator](https://termly.io/products/shipping-policy-generator/) — Generates shipping policies that explain shipping methods, costs, delivery expectations, and related ecommerce terms.
- [Accessibility Statement Generator](https://termly.io/products/accessibility-statement-generator/) — Generates accessibility statements that describe a website or app’s accessibility practices, commitments, and contact information.

### Consent Management

- [Consent Management Platform](https://termly.io/products/consent-management-platform/) — Provides tools to manage website consent, including cookie consent, preference management, scanning, and privacy compliance controls.
- [Cookie Consent](https://termly.io/products/cookie-consent-manager/) — Provides cookie consent management tools for collecting and managing visitor preferences for cookies and tracking technologies.
- [Cookie Scanner](https://termly.io/products/cookie-scanner/) — Scans websites to discover, categorize, and review cookies and tracking technologies used on their pages.
- [Cookie Banner Generator](https://termly.io/products/cookie-banner-generator/) — Creates customizable cookie banners for collecting visitor consent and communicating cookie preferences.

## Features

- [Google Consent Mode](https://termly.io/features/google-consent-mode/) — Explains how Termly supports Google Consent Mode for communicating user consent choices to Google services and advertising or analytics technologies.
- [IAB TCF 2.3](https://termly.io/features/iab-tcf/) — Explains Termly’s support for the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework 2.3 and its consent-management requirements.

## Solutions

- [GDPR Compliance](https://termly.io/solutions/gdpr-compliance/) — Provides Termly compliance tools and guidance for businesses addressing GDPR requirements, including privacy policies, consent management, and data subject rights.
- [CCPA/CPRA Compliance](https://termly.io/solutions/ccpa-compliance/) — Provides compliance tools for businesses addressing California privacy requirements, including consumer rights, disclosures, and consent-related requirements.
- [WordPress Privacy Plugin](https://termly.io/solutions/wordpress/) — Provides Termly privacy and consent functionality for WordPress websites, including cookie consent and legal policy support.
- [DSAR](https://termly.io/solutions/dsar/) — Provides tools for managing Data Subject Access Requests and helping businesses handle requests involving access, deletion, correction, portability, and related privacy rights.
- [Website Owners](https://termly.io/i-am-a-website-owner/) — Explains Termly’s compliance tools for website owners who need legal policies, cookie consent, and privacy compliance functionality.
- [Marketing Professionals](https://termly.io/i-am-a-marketing-professional/) — Explains how marketing teams can use Termly for consent management, privacy requirements, and compliance-related website operations.
- [Compliance Professionals](https://termly.io/i-am-a-compliance-professional/) — Describes Termly tools relevant to privacy and compliance professionals managing legal policies, consent, and regulatory requirements.
- [Tech Professionals](https://termly.io/i-am-a-tech-professional/) — Describes Termly compliance tools and integrations relevant to developers, technical teams, and technology professionals.

## Key Resources and Guides

### Templates

- [Privacy Policy Template](https://termly.io/resources/templates/privacy-policy-template) — Provides a customizable privacy policy template and explains the information businesses commonly include when documenting their data collection and processing practices.
- [Terms and Conditions Template](https://termly.io/resources/templates/terms-and-conditions-template) — Provides a terms and conditions template covering common rules, responsibilities, restrictions, and provisions for websites and online businesses.
- [Cookie Policy Template](https://termly.io/resources/templates/cookie-policy-template) — Provides a cookie policy template covering common disclosures about cookies, tracking technologies, their purposes, and user choices.
- [EULA Template](https://termly.io/resources/templates/eula) — Provides an End User License Agreement template for apps and software, covering permitted use, restrictions, licensing, and related provisions.

### Guides and Articles

#### Privacy and Legal Policies

- [How to Write a Privacy Policy](https://termly.io/resources/guides/how-to-write-a-privacy-policy) — Explains how to create a privacy policy, including the information to identify, disclosures to include, and steps for tailoring the policy to a business’s data practices.
- [How to Write Terms and Conditions](https://termly.io/resources/guides/how-to-write-terms-and-conditions) — Explains how to create terms and conditions and the types of rules, provisions, and business-specific information they can contain.
- [Privacy Policy vs Terms and Conditions](https://termly.io/resources/articles/privacy-policy-vs-terms-and-conditions) — Explains the differences between privacy policies and terms and conditions, including their purposes, subject matter, and typical use cases.
- [What Is a Privacy Policy?](https://termly.io/resources/articles/what-is-a-privacy-policy) — Defines a privacy policy and explains what it typically covers, including data collection, use, sharing, user rights, and related privacy practices.
- [Privacy Policy for a SaaS Business](https://termly.io/resources/articles/privacy-policy-for-a-saas-business) — Explains privacy policy considerations for SaaS businesses, including account information, product usage data, billing, support interactions, and third-party integrations.
- [Terms and Conditions for AI Companies](https://termly.io/resources/articles/terms-and-conditions-for-ai-companies) — Explains terms and conditions considerations for AI companies, including rules governing AI products, user responsibilities, and service use.

#### Cookies and Consent Management

- [What Is a Consent Management Platform](https://termly.io/resources/articles/what-is-a-consent-management-platform) — Explains what a consent management platform is, how it is used to manage consent, and when websites may need consent management functionality.
- [What Is a Cookie Consent Manager](https://termly.io/resources/articles/what-is-a-cookie-consent-manager) — Explains what a cookie consent manager is and how it helps websites collect and manage visitor choices about cookies and tracking technologies.
- [Cookie Consent Requirements for Website Owners](https://termly.io/resources/articles/cookie-consent-requirements-for-website-owners) — Explains cookie consent requirements relevant to website owners and the circumstances in which visitors may need to provide consent.
- [GDPR Cookie Consent](https://termly.io/resources/articles/gdpr-cookie-consent) — Explains GDPR-related cookie consent requirements and how websites can approach consent for cookies and tracking technologies.
- [How to Comply With Google Consent Mode](https://termly.io/resources/articles/how-to-comply-with-google-consent-mode) — Explains how websites can implement Google Consent Mode and configure consent signals for Google services.
- [Cookie Banner](https://termly.io/resources/articles/cookie-banner) — Explains what cookie banners are, what they communicate to website visitors, and how they are used to collect or manage cookie consent.

#### Broader Compliance

- [Google Play Store Privacy Policy Updates](https://termly.io/resources/articles/google-play-store-privacy-policy-updates) — Explains privacy policy requirements and updates relevant to apps distributed through the Google Play Store.
- [Legal Requirements for Websites](https://termly.io/resources/articles/legal-requirements-for-websites) — Covers common legal and compliance requirements that website owners may need to address when operating a website.
- [Legal Requirements for Apps](https://termly.io/resources/articles/legal-requirements-for-apps) — Covers common legal and compliance requirements relevant to mobile and software applications.
- [GDPR Checklist for Small Businesses](https://termly.io/resources/checklists/gdpr-checklist-for-small-businesses) — Provides a checklist of GDPR compliance areas for small businesses to review when assessing their privacy practices and obligations.

## Competitors

- [Termly vs Cookiebot](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-cookiebot) — Compares Termly and Cookiebot across compliance and consent-management capabilities to help businesses evaluate the two solutions.
- [Termly vs iubenda](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-iubenda) — Compares Termly and iubenda across privacy compliance, legal policies, consent management, and related product capabilities.
- [Termly vs CookieYes](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-cookieyes) — Compares Termly and CookieYes across cookie consent, privacy compliance, and related website compliance functionality.
- [Termly vs OneTrust](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-onetrust) — Compares Termly and OneTrust across privacy compliance, consent management, and related compliance capabilities.
- [Termly vs Usercentrics](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-usercentrics) — Compares Termly and Usercentrics across consent management and privacy compliance functionality.
- [Termly vs TermsFeed](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-termsfeed) — Compares Termly and TermsFeed across legal policy generation and privacy compliance capabilities.
- [Termly vs Osano](https://termly.io/resources/compare/termly-vs-osano) — Compares Termly and Osano across privacy compliance, consent management, and related website compliance capabilities.

## Company

- [About Us](https://termly.io/about-us/) — Describes Termly’s history, mission, business, compliance platform, and the company’s focus on making data compliance easier for businesses.
- [Our Commitment to Privacy](https://termly.io/resources/our-commitment-to-privacy/) — Explains Termly’s approach to privacy, GDPR adherence, data protection practices, individual rights, and related privacy controls.
- [Privacy Center](https://termly.io/privacy-center/) — Centralizes information about Termly’s privacy principles, policies, data rights, compliance practices, security, and privacy-related requests.
- [Updates and Press](https://termly.io/updates-press/) — Collects Termly company news, product updates, collaborations, announcements, and other press-related information.
- [Partner with Us](https://termly.io/partners/) — Describes Termly’s agency, affiliate, and technical partnership programs for organizations that want to resell, refer, or integrate Termly.
- [Pricing](https://termly.io/pricing/) — Describes Termly’s available plans, pricing structure, included features, and differences between Free, Starter, Pro+, and Agency plans.
